semiconductor_relevance: High — Efab specializes in manufacturing equipment for the semiconductor industry, particularly in MOCVD reactors and related services.
summary: Efab International Technology Co., Ltd. provides new and used manufacturing equipment for the compound semiconductor, solar/PV, and flat panel display industries. They focus on MOCVD reactors, offering system sales, service representation, and asset management solutions to enhance profitability for their clients.
capabilities: Direct replacement spare parts for MOCVD systems

regional_presence.Taiwan: Efab operates as an independent unit based in Taiwan, focusing on the re-marketing of MOCVD and related equipment.
